app_info.subtitle:
Streamer Match Assistant
Auto Win/Loss Counter

faqs.a: Please make sure your game display mode is set to 'Borderless Windowed' or 'Windowed'. Fullscreen exclusive mode or overlapping windows may prevent screen capture.

faqs.q: Consecutive matches are not counted immediately
faqs.a: To prevent duplicate counting, there is a 25-second cooldown period after each detection before the next match can be detected.

faqs.q: Counter is not showing in OBS
faqs.a: Verify the Browser Source URL is set to 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/counter' and not blocked by firewall/antivirus software.
